findings.title: Glassworm Hacks OVH Clouds CLI tool
findings.summary_md: On 19 October 2026 between 12:47 and 13:12 UTC, an attacker replaced release binaries of five OVHcloud CLI versions (v0.11.0 to v0.15.0) through the compromised GitHub contributor account HassenBF. The malicious binary was a secret-stealing build compiled from a dirty local checkout (commit 5ead8ef) rather than through the project's GoReleaser pipeline.

findings.title: Issue #300: Release assets of v0.13.0–v0.15.0 replaced on 2026-10-19 with a dirty build of a later commit
findings.summary_md: A downstream CI job that pinned a SHA-256 for the Linux arm64 tarball of v0.15.0 failed, exposing the replacement. The reporter captured the malicious binary's build metadata (`vcs.modified=true`, pseudo-version `v0.15.1-0.20261013083505-5ead8ef9b43d+dirty`) before OVHcloud deleted the replaced assets at 14:21 UTC.

findings.title: OVHcloud : un hacker piège plusieurs versions de son CLI officiel
findings.summary_md: French cybersecurity outlet reported on 19 October 2026 that OVHcloud confirmed the compromise: for roughly 94 minutes, several CLI versions distributed from GitHub were replaced with a malicious binary designed to steal secrets stored on user disks.
